part.text:
Fixed in `src/script.c:660`: the no-touch check now inspects the actual executing command (`server.executing_client`) instead of the caller's command, so `TOUCH` inside a script is recognized even when the calling client is in no-touch mode.

Validation:
- `unit/introspection-2` — all passed, including both TOUCH no-touch tests.
- `unit/scripting` — all passed.
- `unit/expire` — only an unrelated timing-sensitive TTL/AOF test failed (expected 90–98, got 71); no-touch logic is not involved.
